scope: Exact AC1014 NOD 0x0c with ACAD_GROUP, ACAD_MLINESTYLE and ACDBVARIABLEDICTIONARY; dictionary 0x22 and DIMADEC variable 0x23; MLINESTYLE dictionary 0x1a and STANDARD style 0x1b. ASCII and Binary DXF AC1014 output only.
authority: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 sections 20.4.44, 20.4.73 and 20.4.74. The R14 DICTIONARY byte is kept at the observed zero value and is not generalized.
implementation: Bound the common DICTIONARYVAR handle tail to the AC1014 body end, check owner/reactor/extension roles and publish typed common evidence. Observe the exact same-import NOD, owner, DICTIONARYVAR, MLINESTYLE owner and style source bits, prove staged identities and graph, and recheck source bytes and model at finalization.

External DWG and derived DXFs are not committed.

The actual AC1014 target is separately checked by fresh libdxfrw readback and the ASCII header.

validation.consumerCompatibility: PASS: existing lc3_compat_check C++ object builds against changed sources; this is a compile-only 2D adapter guard, not native LibreCAD behavior.

limitations: One externally sourced drawing with unknown producer. No broad AC1014 support, other DICTIONARYVAR or MLINESTYLE profiles, native CAD semantics, consumer behavior, native platform matrix, or release qualification is implied. CLASSES, other objects and 2D/3D features remain subject to their own gates. No support-status claim is promoted.
